history.body: Hi, I’m looking at Pearl Residences because we’re hoping to buy somewhere around Seberang Jaya. Could you tell me what the 3-bedroom units are like and roughly what the monthly costs would be?

The Phase 1 three-bedroom Type A is 900 sq.ft., with 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The living, dining and kitchen are open-plan, and the layout avoids a long internal corridor. At RM0.18 per sq.ft., maintenance including sinking fund works out to about RM162 per month. That’s the maintenance estimate only; selected clubhouse facilities are pay-per-use, and I don’t have a confirmed figure for any other mandatory recurring charges yet.

Thanks, that gives me a clearer idea of the layout and the maintenance amount. Could you check the current Type A price and whether there are any other mandatory regular charges? I’d like to understand the overall cost before going further.

Absolutely — I’ll verify the latest Type A pricing and applicable package rather than give you a stale quote. The reference pricing I have is RM328,000–RM358,000 base, but it’s indicative only, not a confirmed current total; floor, facing and car-park configuration can affect the figure, and the applicable package also needs checking. The check on any other mandatory recurring charges is still pending; for now, RM162/month is the maintenance estimate only. I’ll share what’s confirmed so you can assess the overall cost before deciding whether to go further.
